summary: Kennametal Inc. filed an 8-K on May 27, 2026, announcing the pricing and final results of a cash tender offer to purchase any and all of its 4.625% Senior Notes due 2028. The consideration was determined by a fixed spread over the bid-side yield of specified U.S. Treasury Securities as of 2:00 p.m. NYC time on May 26, 2026. The offer was conducted via an Offer to Purchase dated May 19, 2026, with pricing terms detailed in the press release. This is a debt tender offer by the issuer to reduce leverage.
